scenes.summary: While heading towards Qingbo Stockade, you run into Tangtang. She tries to tell you that she is here to pick you up. In truth, she is thinking about repairing the broken bridge.

lines.text: Of course not! Look, I'm GENUINELY concerned for all of you!
I don't wanna be seen by those pesky watchguards!
Tangtang?
Oh — Ah. I, uh ... I'm here to pick you up!
This isn't another trick of yours, right?
Ahem. Get this bridge fixed, then we'll head to the ⟦key|Stockade⟧ together!
Come on! Just get moving already!

scenes.summary: The residents of Qingbo Stockade warmly welcome your return. With their support, you prepare the construction of the AIC Factory.

lines.text: The Supreme Chief is back! And...
It's you!
Darkmask... I never knew you were so popular here.
Chief told us how you totally embarrassed the Wulingers, and they got down on their fours to beg you for help!
Alright, Fam! Settle down and LISTEN UP! I have specifically SUMMONED Darkmask home to help repair our Stockade!
Everyone knows that our Darkmask is a true professional.
Splatters? Blight? PFFFT! With Darkmask around, they'll be gone in a POOF!
This is actually making me curious... Now I really want to hear Tangtang's stories about you.
Of course. The first step is to verify the deployment site.

options: Let's focus on the real job.
Let's show the Fam our AIC Factory!
How's it going, my good Fam!

scenes.summary: The Stockade residents thank you for your help. Tangtang prepares to leave and solve another Stockade problem. Meanwhile, Ardashir seems to be plotting something...

lines.text: The AIC Factory will help you construct the facilities you need.
...I know we ain't as loaded as Wuling. We don't really have much to offer. But here! Take these!
With you and the AIC Factory around, I can finally let the Fam handle themselves...
Just talk to He Lao if you got problems!
Well, some of our people have been sneaking in and out of the Stockade. Something funny is going on.
Whatever. If something's up, I'll holler at you at once.
Let's start with a farm complex.
My Bro's always busy, so I gotta look into it myself.
They probably have side jobs or something. The Stockade isn't doing too well, you know.
And once I get the fort tidied up, I'll take you on a tour of our ⟦key|Ancestral Spring⟧! Promise!
He accepted, but he did not agree.
Now, how can we proceed without incurring too many sacrifices ... Endministrator?
Hahahaha!
